description: List PR security review runs with the issues each found, newest first, 15 a page. Filter by repository, run status and conclusion, or sort by openFindings to see the reviews with the most open issues first. Totals cover the filters. Call get_pr_review for one review's issues. The grouped PR Reviews page's views and search are not available here.
